document:0:413:0.text:
Use one portion of <style="highlight">vitality essence</style> (refined from pure, farm-raised wingroaches) as the base.
Take two bundles of <style="highlight">moonleaves</style> over three years old and grind them. Add the powder to the base and bring it to a boil twice.
Add four drops of <style="highlight">fiery plasma</style>, then heat the mixture once more.
Finally, rapidly cool the mixture with magic for precipitation, then collect the clear liquid from the top.
document:0:413:0.source_cn:
以一份<style="highlight">康复基液</style>（必须由纯净的养殖飞蠊熬煮精淬制成）为药剂基底。
两把生长时间三年以上的<style="highlight">新月草</style>研磨，加入基底药液中，煮沸两轮。
滴入四滴<style="highlight">炽热血浆</style>后，再加热一轮。
最后，需要用魔法迅速使药剂冷凝沉淀，取用上层清澈的部分。
